policy.pricing_text: FRAs at the 17 Jun close (1x4 3.86, 3x6 3.87, 6x9 3.95, 9x12 4.01 vs WIBOR 3M 3.85) price roughly 15bp of NBP hikes within 12 months. The MPC held at 3.75% on 2 Jun (May CPI eased mainly on food; decisions stay data-dependent); Glapiński (3 Jun): lower May CPI cuts the hike odds, rates are high enough and there is no reason to change or even discuss them. Kotecki (15 Jun): rate changes unlikely to end-2026, hike appetite lower, too early to signal cuts; Dąbrowski (12 Jun): a cut now more likely than a hike. May CPI 3.1% (final, 15 Jun; flash 29 May, 3.7% expected); core 3.1% (16 Jun). Standard fuel excise is back from 15 Jun; VAT 8% and price caps run to 30 June, with a VAT decision due 'shortly' (Tusk, 16 Jun).
policy.risk_text: Strong demand at the 17 Jun sale (cover 1.52) and a dovish MPC pulled the 10Y to ~5.40%; risks: the hawkish Fed dots lifted US 2Y yields, CPI may rise as fuel support is withdrawn (VAT after 30 Jun), and the US-Iran MoU is fragile; one more sale on 24 Jun.

macro.projection_text: NBP March projection (4 Mar; data to 19 Feb, war excluded): CPI 50% bands 1.6-2.9% (2026), 1.1-3.7% (2027); central path 2.3% / 2.4% / 2.3% (2026-28), GDP 3.9% in 2026; IMF (14 Apr): 2026 CPI 3.3%; EC (21 May): GDP 3.5% in 2026; OECD (June outlook): CPI 3.7% in 2026, no cuts before Q2 2027; Fitch (8 Jun): GDP 3.3%, NBP flat at 3.75% to year-end; World Bank (11 Jun): GDP 3.1% / 2.6%. The July projection is the next marker.
macro.fiscal_text: 2025 general-government deficit 7.3% of GDP (GUS EDP, 22 Apr), debt 59.7%; 2026 deficit cap PLN 271.7bn; budget deficit after May PLN 108.2bn (~40% of the limit, 15 Jun); the government's assumptions put the 2026 deficit at ~6.8% of GDP; EC (21 May): 6.5%, debt 64.5%; EKF consensus (2 Jun): 6.9%; EDP debt 61.6% of GDP at end-Q1 (10 Jun); 2027 budget path (9 Jun): GDP 3.1%, CPI 2.5%; the government adopted the windfall tax (16 Jun); fuel package (VAT 8%, price caps) to 30 June, standard excise back from 15 June.
macro.fiscal_risk_text: 2026 needs ~56% (MoF, 29 May) financed; budget accounts PLN 208.3bn at end-May (MoF, 8 Jun); 3 Jun switch (MoF database): PLN 11.63bn sold (demand 12.84bn) vs 10.90bn bought back (PS0527 7.42bn), net +0.73bn; OK0129 4.812%, PS0731 5.269%, DS0436 5.703%; BGK priced EUR 2bn of FPC bonds (2 Jun). S&P A-/stable (affirmed 8 May); Scope A negative (15 May); Fitch A- and Moody's A2 have negative outlooks; Fitch's June forecast round (8 Jun) was not a rating action.
macro.backdrop_text: The NBP held at 3.75% on 2 Jun; May CPI 3.1% y/y; Q1 GDP 3.5% y/y (second estimate). Ratings: Fitch A- negative, Moody's A2 negative, S&P A- stable. 17 Jun: MoF sold PLN 12.0bn (offer 7-12bn) at 18.3bn demand, cover 1.52 (3-month high). PS0731 4.44bn at 4.918%, DS0436 2.40bn at 5.416%, OK0129 1.93bn at 4.399%, DS1030 1.09bn at 4.711%. NBP's Sobon: no policy cycle. NIK: the 2025 SRW limit was overstated by PLN 84.5bn; the Fiscal Council wants faster consolidation. ING: MPC more dovish than priced; 10Y ~5.4%, a 3-month low; DS0436 5.40%. Abroad: the Fed held at 3.50-3.75% (12-0) in Warsh's first meeting with a terse 'will deliver price stability' statement; the median dot rose to 3.8% for end-2026 (9 of 18 see hikes), PCE 3.6%; a year-end hike became fully priced, UST2 +16bp to 4.21%, DXY >100.3. UK May CPI held at 2.8% (3.0% expected); EZ HICP 3.2% confirmed (core 2.6%); Bund 2.93%; Brent ~$79-80; US retail sales +0.9%; Riksbank held.

calendar.plan_text: MoF June plan (29 May): one switch on 3 Jun (settles 8 Jun; buys back DS0726, PS1026, WZ1126, OK0127, PS0527) and sale auctions on 17 and 24 Jun (PLN 6-12bn each) in OK0129, NZ0331, PS0731, DS0436 and NZ0936; no T-bills; ~56% of 2026 needs financed. 3 Jun switch (MoF database): PLN 11.63bn sold (demand 12.84bn) vs 10.90bn bought back (PS0527 7.42bn), net +0.73bn; OK0129 4.812%, PS0731 5.269%, DS0436 5.703%. 17 Jun sale: PLN 12.00bn vs 18.27bn demand (cover 1.52); OK0129 4.399%, PS0731 4.918%, DS1030 4.711%, DS0436 5.416%. BGK priced EUR 2bn of FPC bonds on 2 Jun; FPC switch on 18 Jun (buys back FPC0427).
calendar.timing_text: The Aug 2025-Feb 2026 pattern (auction-day close the cheapest point of the week) comes from a rally regime; March's sell-off broke it and April's auction days cheapened on average. Remaining June operations: 24 Jun. Next MPC in July, with the NBP projection: a hold is expected. Covers: 1.52 (17 Jun) vs 1.25-1.33 in May.

core_text: Regime: a preliminary US-Iran deal - Brent towards $80, core yields at two-month lows; the NBP held at 3.75% on 2 Jun while FRAs price roughly 15bp of NBP hikes; the ECB hiked to 2.25% on 11 Jun with one more hike priced, the Fed signals a 2026 hike in its dots, the BoE is priced for hikes, the CNB is on hold and the MNB is on hold. Poland's 5Y CDS was 50bp and the 10Y spread to Bunds 251bp on benchmark bonds (Erste, 17 Jun close). Hawkish Fed dots: 3.8% for end-2026 (17 Jun).
